title: Repossession and Collateral Recovery Agency Assignment and Recall Standard
content:
Desk standard of the Recovery Department for referral, assignment to a recovery agency and recall of a Repossession and Collateral Recovery case.

## 1. Referral

A contract is referred for repossession review only while it is active and at least the class referral minimum of days past due (60 days past due in every class), or when the borrower asks to surrender the vehicle voluntarily (recovery method voluntary surrender), or when the vehicle is held in an impound and released to the company as lienholder (recovery method impound release).

## 2. Assignment after the cure period

A case may be assigned to an agency only after the cure period that the right-to-cure schedule sets for the contract state has run from the date the right-to-cure notice was mailed, without the default being cured. The cure period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the notice was mailed, and assignment is allowed only from the day after its last day; a contract whose state is not listed in the right-to-cure schedule needs no cure notice.

The clock rests on the system record of the right-to-cure notice on the case (its mailing date) and on the contract state; a borrower's statement about a notice does not replace that record.

*Boundary illustration (hypothetical dates, contract state ME with a 14-day cure period):* a notice mailed on 1 March has a cure period running 2 March through 15 March. Assignment on 15 March is not allowed; assignment on 16 March is allowed, provided the default has not been cured.

## 3. Recalls

| Fact on record | Outcome |
|---|---|
| The contract was incurred before the borrower's active-duty start date and the borrower is in military service, with no court order | Not assigned; the case is recalled with recall reason SCRA protection (a court order is required, 50 U.S.C. 3952). |
| A bankruptcy filing is on record | The case is recalled at once with recall reason bankruptcy filing (11 U.S.C. 362 automatic stay). |
| The borrower brings the contract current (next due date no earlier than the payment date) before the vehicle is recovered | Recalled with recall reason account brought current. |
| An assignment has no recovery within 60 days (the class assignment expiry) of the assignment date | Recalled with recall reason assignment expired. |
| A referral was made outside the conditions of section 1 | Recalled with recall reason referral error. |

## 4. Conduct of the recovery

The agency must use the class's tow equipment (wheel-lift for Recovery Class 1 Passenger Car, Recovery Class 2 Minivan and Crossover and Recovery Class 3 Sport Utility Vehicle; flatbed for Recovery Class 4 Light-Duty Pickup and Recovery Class 5 Heavy-Duty Pickup; medium-duty flatbed for Recovery Class 6 Full-Size Van) and must withdraw without the vehicle when the borrower objects at the scene or a closed structure would have to be entered (UCC 9-609).

## 5. Charges never passed to the borrower

No close fee for a recalled assignment and no skip-tracing cost is ever charged to the borrower.
